svg.title: RentARoom Buea system architecture
svg.desc: Five-layer architecture: students and landlords connect to an HTML/Bootstrap frontend, which calls a FastAPI backend with auth, listings, and ML predictor modules, reading from SQLite and a trained model file. A DevOps pipeline shows Docker flowing through GitHub Actions to Render.com.
